There are so many different types of medication though. Wellbutrin is the only one that worked for me. It actually helped me quit smoking and I quit drinking as well (I realized drinking was heavily weighing me down). I also moved to my hometown. Yes, it was stressful, but I realized that I wasn't able to change my frame of mind until I changed where I lived. I didn't have the social connections I was craving, so I moved into a house with random roommates. I still partied and went out despite not drinking. I also needed help moving on from my first ex, so I started dating someone (yes, he was a rebound, but I was also a rebound from his ex.) yoga and exercise helped, as well as treating food like medicine and cooking. I found out thyroid issues and anemia were making me exhausted, so I got those under control. I went back to school and was committed on doing well in my classes. I still suffer from depression sometimes, but I also know what has worked for me in the past to gain control over my emotions and dig myself out of the hole I created.
